Around 450 employees work at the Swiss locations Zurich, Bern and Lausanne.

This is the job - your main tasks

• You don't just want to shape, but really make a difference? In this role, you take on a central responsibility for further expanding our Cloud Readiness, Strategy & GRC area. • You design our cloud consulting portfolio, develop our team and drive the further development of methods and tools around Cloud-Services.

This job is for you if

• You have at least five years of experience in the field of cloud-Services – ideally in a leading role on the customer side or in their consulting.

• You have sound, proven know-how in cloud strategy, cloud architecture, cloud transformations or operations.

• You think entrepreneurially, like to work in a team and implement projects with a high focus on results. You share our conviction that every cloud project is also a change project.

• You have fun actively maintaining existing relationships and building new customers and strategic partnerships.

• You have experience in the design, construction and operation of hybrid cloud environments.

• You enjoy strengthening existing customer relationships, attracting new customers and actively expanding strategic partnerships.

• you have an excellent degree in computer science, business computer science or comparable.

• You have very good knowledge of German and English in word and writing. French would be a big plus.

Que ce soit pour façonner des organisations prêtes à l'avenir, pour libérer de nouveaux potentiels grâce aux données et à l'IA, ou pour renforcer les entreprises grâce à la cybersécurité holistique, nous obtenons des résultats de manière pragmatique et ciblée. Environ 460 employés travaillent dans nos bureaux suisses à Zurich, Berne et Lausanne.
